test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 6 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the word given in bold in the following sentence.

Forgetting the past is __**inevitable**__** **for being able to create a future.
solution:
The correct answer is '**inescapable'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate synonym of the word given in bold in "**inevitable**" is inescapable.
 
• **Inescapable - **Unable to be avoided or denied.
 
 
• **​***For example : "Political reform was inescapable."*
 
 
 
• *​*Therefore **option 1 **is the correct option.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's discuss information about other options:
 
 
• **Extravagant - **Lacking restraint in spending money or using resources.** **

 
 
• ​*For example : "It was rather extravagant to by both cars."*
 
 
 
• **Privileged - **Having special rights, advantages, or immunities.
 
 
• ​*For example : "In the nineteenth century only a privileged few had the vote."*
 
 
 
• **Unpredictable - **Not able to be predicted; changeable.
 
 
• ​*For example : "The unpredictable weather of the Scottish island."*
 
 
 
 

4a:Tebf,
